definition.ko: 제품 자체를 주인공으로 선명하고 매력적으로 보여 줍니다.
definition.en: The product is the star, shown clearly and attractively.

terms.implementationHint: Keep the product centered and readable; slow reveal, clean lighting, stable silhouette.

definition.ko: 문구가 주된 비주얼이며 메시지에 맞춰 움직입니다.
definition.en: Text is the main visual and moves with the message.

terms.implementationHint: Animate text blocks as graphic objects; each line has one idea; keep exact copy.

definition.ko: 일상 장면 속에서 제품을 보여 줍니다.
definition.en: Shows the product inside daily-life moments.

terms.implementationHint: Build simple scene compositions with the product integrated naturally.

definition.en: A character drives the story and interacts with the product.

terms.implementationHint: Define silhouette, pose timing and gestures explicitly; keep appearance consistent.

definition.ko: 느리고 감성적인 영화적 언어로 브랜드 아이디어를 전합니다.
definition.en: Slow, emotional film language that carries a brand idea.

terms.implementationHint: Prefer slow camera and light changes over text; long holds.

definition.en: Refined, high-end product movement and lighting.

terms.implementationHint: Controlled easing, soft highlights, minimal composition.

definition.en: Rounded, friendly 3D look with soft lighting.

terms.implementationHint: Rounded geometry, matte materials, soft shadows.

definition.en: CG that looks like real photography.

terms.implementationHint: Physically plausible materials, lighting and camera.

definition.en: Non-literal shapes and movement carry the mood.

terms.implementationHint: Generative shapes driven by time; no literal objects required.

definition.en: An image stands in for the message.

terms.implementationHint: One clear metaphor with a clean transformation.

definition.ko: 서로 다른 질감과 매체를 한 화면에 결합합니다.
definition.en: Different textures and media combined into one piece.

terms.implementationHint: Layer flat cutouts, paper and photo textures with stepped motion.

definition.en: Magazine-like layouts, grids and type.

terms.implementationHint: Grid-based composition, strong type hierarchy, restrained motion.

definition.en: Information shown through animated charts and diagrams.

terms.implementationHint: Animate values with clear easing; label every figure exactly.

definition.en: Interface and device demonstrations.

terms.implementationHint: Crisp UI elements, snapping transitions, device-accurate proportions.

definition.en: A logo animation or brand signature.

terms.implementationHint: Anticipate, build, reveal, settle; hold the final logo.

definition.en: Several scenes joined by transitions.

terms.implementationHint: One beat per shot; set transitionOut for each beat.

definition.en: One uninterrupted flow of camera or space.

terms.implementationHint: Describe time ranges, not shots; keep object continuity.

definition.ko: 긴 연속 장면에 일부 명확한 컷을 결합합니다.
definition.en: Long continuous passages plus a few clear cuts.

terms.implementationHint: Mix continuous ranges with hard cuts where the idea changes.

definition.ko: 훅 → 소비자 상황 → 제품 → 정보 → 브랜드 → 엔드카드.
definition.en: Hook, situation, product, information, brand, end card.

terms.implementationHint: Role order: hook, situation, product, information, brand, end-card.

definition.en: A problem, tension, then the product resolves it.

terms.implementationHint: Role order: problem, tension, product, resolution, brand.

definition.ko: 순간 → 생활 맥락 → 제품 → 브랜드 감성 → 엔드카드.
definition.en: A moment, context, product integration, brand feeling.

terms.implementationHint: Role order: moment, context, integration, feeling, end-card.

definition.ko: 미스터리 → 질감 디테일 → 제품 공개 → 브랜드 시그니처.
definition.en: Mystery, material detail, product reveal, signature.

terms.implementationHint: Role order: mystery, detail, reveal, signature.

definition.ko: 초기 상태 → 변형 → 제품·메시지 공개 → 해결.
definition.en: Initial state, transformation, reveal, resolution.

terms.implementationHint: Role order: initial, transformation, reveal, resolution.

definition.ko: 훅 카피 → 리듬 카피 → 제품·메시지 → 브랜드 타격.
definition.en: Hook copy, rhythmic copy, product or message, brand hit.

terms.implementationHint: Role order: hook-copy, rhythm, message, brand-hit.

definition.ko: 감정·아이디어 → 비주얼 전개 → 브랜드 철학 → 로고.
definition.en: Emotion or idea, visuals, philosophy, logo.

terms.implementationHint: Role order: idea, development, philosophy, logo.

definition.ko: 상황 → 행동 → 제품 상호작용 → 반응 → 브랜드.
definition.en: Situation, action, product interaction, reaction, brand.

terms.implementationHint: Role order: situation, action, interaction, reaction, brand.

definition.en: Anticipation, build, logo reveal, settle.

terms.implementationHint: Role order: anticipation, build, reveal, settle.

definition.en: A bold tone of voice.

terms.implementationHint: Write copy with a bold rhythm and word choice.

definition.en: A playful tone of voice.

terms.implementationHint: Write copy with a playful rhythm and word choice.

definition.en: A sophisticated tone of voice.

terms.implementationHint: Write copy with a sophisticated rhythm and word choice.

definition.en: A premium tone of voice.

terms.implementationHint: Write copy with a premium rhythm and word choice.

definition.en: A restrained tone of voice.

terms.implementationHint: Write copy with a restrained rhythm and word choice.

definition.en: A youthful tone of voice.

terms.implementationHint: Write copy with a youthful rhythm and word choice.

definition.en: A energetic tone of voice.

terms.implementationHint: Write copy with a energetic rhythm and word choice.

definition.en: A technical tone of voice.

terms.implementationHint: Write copy with a technical rhythm and word choice.

definition.en: A warm tone of voice.

terms.implementationHint: Write copy with a warm rhythm and word choice.

definition.en: A confident tone of voice.

terms.implementationHint: Write copy with a confident rhythm and word choice.

definition.en: A witty tone of voice.

terms.implementationHint: Write copy with a witty rhythm and word choice.

definition.en: A minimal tone of voice.

terms.implementationHint: Write copy with a minimal rhythm and word choice.

definition.ko: 문구가 한 축을 따라 미끄러지듯 들어오거나 나갑니다.
definition.en: Text glides in or out along an axis.

terms.implementationHint: translate with ease-out; 300-600ms; one direction per beat.

definition.ko: 문구가 탄성 있게 빠르게 커지며 나타납니다.
definition.en: Text appears with a quick springy scale-in.

terms.implementationHint: scale 0.8 to 1 with easeOutBack, 200-350ms.

definition.ko: 강조를 위해 짧게 크기를 키웠다 되돌립니다.
definition.en: A sharp, brief overshoot in size for emphasis.

terms.implementationHint: scale 1 to 1.12 to 1 with easeOutBack, 250-400ms.

definition.en: Letter spacing opens up.

terms.implementationHint: animate letter-spacing from tight to wide, ease-in-out.

definition.en: Letter spacing closes in.

terms.implementationHint: animate letter-spacing from wide to tight, ease-out.

definition.en: The same text repeats in rhythm.

terms.implementationHint: stagger identical copies at fixed intervals; identical spelling for every copy.

definition.en: Text is revealed by a moving mask.

terms.implementationHint: clip-path inset animated from 100% to 0%.

definition.en: Oversized letters cropped by the frame.

terms.implementationHint: scale type beyond the frame; keep key glyphs readable.

definition.ko: 여러 줄을 한 덩어리로 촘촘히 쌓습니다.
definition.en: Lines stacked tightly as one block.

terms.implementationHint: tight line-height, staggered line entrance.

definition.en: Characters assemble into the final word.

terms.implementationHint: move whole syllable blocks (not jamo) into place, then hold the complete word.

definition.en: Text locks into place with a hard, quick stop.

terms.implementationHint: short linear or ease-out move ending in an abrupt stop; optional 1-frame shake.

definition.ko: 속이 빈 윤곽선 잔상이 문구를 따라갑니다.
definition.en: An outline echo trails the solid text.

terms.implementationHint: duplicate text as stroke-only layer with delayed offset and low opacity.

definition.en: An object circles around a center.

terms.implementationHint: rotate around a pivot at constant radius; ease-in-out.

definition.en: A folded shape opens up.

terms.implementationHint: animate hinge rotations in sequence.

definition.en: Parts come together into one object.

terms.implementationHint: move parts from offset positions to final positions with stagger.

definition.en: An object bursts into pieces.

terms.implementationHint: pieces move outward with deterministic offsets derived from index.

definition.en: Separate elements join into one.

terms.implementationHint: interpolate positions and shapes to a single target.

definition.en: Elements fall or enter one after another.

terms.implementationHint: stagger by index with constant delay.

definition.en: Elements are pulled toward a point.

terms.implementationHint: ease-in toward the target; speed increases near it.

definition.en: Plain rotation about an axis.

terms.implementationHint: rotate with ease-in-out; avoid uncontrolled spin.

definition.en: Tumbling, multi-axis rotation.

terms.implementationHint: rotate on two axes with different periods.

definition.en: A squash-and-stretch response.

terms.implementationHint: scale x/y inversely with spring easing.

definition.en: An object compresses before acting.

terms.implementationHint: scale down along one axis, then release.

definition.en: An object grows outward.

terms.implementationHint: scale up with ease-out.

definition.en: Camera moves closer to the subject.

terms.implementationHint: move camera forward or increase scale slowly; ease-in-out.

definition.en: Camera moves away to reveal context.

terms.implementationHint: move camera backward or decrease scale; ease-out.

definition.en: Camera travels along a path.

terms.implementationHint: translate camera along one axis at steady speed.

definition.en: Camera circles the subject.

terms.implementationHint: rotate camera around the subject at fixed radius.

definition.en: Camera rises or lowers vertically.

terms.implementationHint: translate camera on the Y axis with ease-in-out.

definition.en: Layers drift at different speeds.

terms.implementationHint: move layers with depth-proportional offsets.

definition.en: Close tracking along a surface.

terms.implementationHint: short focal distance, slow lateral move.

definition.en: Focus shifts between depths.

terms.implementationHint: animate blur amounts of foreground and background inversely.

definition.en: Camera moves through a surface or object.

terms.implementationHint: move camera through the plane with a cover frame or dissolve.

definition.en: A fixed camera.

terms.implementationHint: no camera movement.

definition.en: Shape flows like liquid into another.

terms.implementationHint: interpolate between signed-distance or path shapes with smooth easing.

definition.en: Particles gather into a form.

terms.implementationHint: particle positions from index-seeded start to target; no unseeded randomness.

definition.en: A form dissolves into volume or smoke.

terms.implementationHint: fade with noise threshold driven by t.

definition.en: Glass bends the view behind it.

terms.implementationHint: use a refraction material or fake with offset and blur.

definition.en: Metal shapes extrude from a surface.

terms.implementationHint: animate extrusion depth with ease-out; specular highlights.

definition.en: Detail grows across a surface.

terms.implementationHint: reveal pattern by growing mask radius.

definition.en: A cloth lifts to reveal the product.

terms.implementationHint: animate a deformed plane lifting away.

definition.en: A fluid pushes things aside.

terms.implementationHint: displace positions with a moving wave field.

definition.en: Crystal-like shapes grow.

terms.implementationHint: grow faceted geometry by stepped scale.

definition.en: An immediate cut.

terms.implementationHint: switch scene at the beat boundary; no overlap.

definition.en: A cut that matches shape or motion.

terms.implementationHint: align position, scale and motion across the cut.

definition.en: A mask shape wipes to the next scene.

terms.implementationHint: animate clip-path across the frame.

definition.en: A circle opens onto the next scene.

terms.implementationHint: animate circle clip-path radius from 0.

definition.en: A shape expands into the next scene.

terms.implementationHint: scale a shape layer to cover the frame.

definition.en: A moving object sweeps the frame.

terms.implementationHint: move a large object across, switching scene behind it.

definition.en: Move through depth into the next scene.

terms.implementationHint: scale up the outgoing layer while fading, then the incoming settles.

definition.en: The environment transforms into the next.

terms.implementationHint: cross-interpolate colors and shapes of the background.

definition.en: Pass through an object into the next scene.

terms.implementationHint: move the camera through a surface to reveal the next scene.

definition.en: One scene fades into the next.

terms.implementationHint: opacity ease-in-out over the overlap.

definition.en: Next scene slides in from the right.

terms.implementationHint: translateX with ease-in-out.

definition.en: Next scene slides in from the left.

terms.implementationHint: translateX with ease-in-out, mirrored.

definition.en: Next scene slides in from the bottom.

terms.implementationHint: translateY with ease-in-out.

definition.en: Next scene slides in from the top.

terms.implementationHint: translateY with ease-in-out, mirrored.

definition.en: Zoom into the next scene.

terms.implementationHint: scale outgoing up and incoming from smaller to 1.
